adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, if the parsed token data lacks `refresh_token`, it is forcibly set to the literal string "refresh_token" (lines ~24-27). Call sites then merge/store this parsed data back into persisted credentials. For example, in `Office365CalendarService.ts`, `tokenResponse.data` is spread into `o365AuthCredentials` and later written to Prisma; if the refresh response omits `refresh_token` (common for OAuth refresh), the placeholder will overwrite the real stored refresh token, corrupting credentials. Similar risk exists where the parsed token is used for updates (e.g., Zoom).
